# react-polaroid-carousel

**Photo carousels that feel like memories.** A tiny React carousel that stacks your photos like tilted polaroids. Swipe it, let it autoplay, theme it with CSS variables, or go fully headless with `useCarousel`.



**[Live demo and 8 examples, including the new lightbox →](https://kushalbhanot.github.io/react-polaroid-carousel/)**

- **~4 kB** min+gzip, **zero dependencies** (just React 18 or 19)
- **SSR-safe**: identical HTML on server and client, no layout shift, works in Next.js App Router, Remix, Astro
- **Accessible** by default, following the [W3C APG carousel pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/carousel/) and WCAG 2.2.2
- **Smooth**: GPU transforms only, no React re-render per drag frame, only nearby slides are mounted
- **Customisable**: 20+ optional props, CSS variables, class name slots, `renderImage` / `renderSlide`, `unstyled`, and a headless hook
- **TypeScript** first, ESM, tree-shakeable

```bash
npm install react-polaroid-carousel
```

```tsx
import { PolaroidCarousel } from "react-polaroid-carousel";

export default function Trip() {
  return (
    <PolaroidCarousel
      items={[
        { src: "/beach.jpg", alt: "Sunset over the beach", caption: "summer '25" },
        { src: "/hike.jpg", alt: "Friends on a mountain trail", caption: "made it!" },
        { src: "/city.jpg", alt: "City skyline at night", caption: "night out" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

That's it: no CSS import, no config, no wrapper needed in Server Components.

## Why another carousel?

Popular carousels keep getting the same bug reports. This one is designed so they can't happen:

| Common problem (from real GitHub issues) | How react-polaroid-carousel avoids it |
| --- | --- |
| Slider renders too wide or zero-height until JS measures it; flicker in Next.js | Pure CSS grid layout. Nothing is measured, so the server HTML is final |
| Infinite loop flashes or breaks with cloned slides | No clones. Looping is index math |
| `aria-hidden` on slides that still contain focus; Lighthouse a11y warnings | Off-screen slides use `inert`, plus APG roles, labels and a live region |
| Swiping the carousel blocks page scroll on phones; passive-listener warnings | Pointer events with `touch-action: pan-y` and axis locking |
| A drag also fires a click on the slide | The click after a real drag is swallowed |
| Autoplay keeps going while you interact | Stops on interaction; pauses on hover, hidden tabs and when off screen |
| Hard to use with Next.js `<Image>`, needs a CSS import, broken TS/ESM types | `renderImage`, inline styles + CSS variables, validated with publint and arethetypeswrong |

## Recipes

### Autoplay

```tsx
<PolaroidCarousel items={items} autoplay={3500} />
```

Autoplay pauses on hover, when the tab is hidden and when the carousel is scrolled off screen. It stops after the user swipes, presses a key or clicks a dot, and shows a pause/play button (required for accessibility). It starts paused if the user prefers reduced motion.

### Lightbox (tap to view full screen)


```tsx
import { PolaroidLightbox } from "react-polaroid-carousel/lightbox";

const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<PolaroidCarousel items={items} index={index} onIndexChange={setIndex} onSlideClick={() => setOpen(true)} />
<PolaroidLightbox items={items} index={index} onIndexChange={setIndex} open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
```

`onSlideClick` puts a real button over the active card, so it works with Enter and Space too, and a swipe never triggers it. The lightbox is a separate entry (about 0.8 kB more when used with the carousel) built on the native `<dialog>`: focus is trapped inside, Esc closes it, focus returns to the card, and the page stops scrolling behind it. Swipe or use the arrow keys to move through photos; sharing `index` keeps the carousel on the photo you closed at.

### Video slides

```tsx
<PolaroidCarousel
  items={[
    { type: "video", src: "/waves.mp4", poster: "/waves.jpg", alt: "Waves breaking", caption: "salt air" },
    { type: "video", src: "/coffee.mp4", poster: "/coffee.jpg", alt: "Coffee being poured" },
  ]}
  style={{ "--rpc-aspect": "9 / 16" } as React.CSSProperties}
/>
```

Only the active card loads and plays its clip (muted, looping, inline); the others show their `poster`, so a page full of clips stays light. Native controls keep the video pausable (WCAG 2.2.2), and it won't autoplay when the user prefers reduced motion. Mix photos and videos freely.

### Next.js `<Image>`

```tsx
import Image from "next/image";

<PolaroidCarousel
  items={items}
  renderImage={(item, { active }) => (
    <Image src={item.src} alt={item.alt} width={600} height={600} priority={active} style={{ width: "100%", height: "auto" }} />
  )}
/>;
```

### Custom slides

Any children become slides:

```tsx
<PolaroidCarousel frame="none" label="Testimonials">
  <blockquote>“Shipped in a day.”</blockquote>
  <blockquote>“Finally, an accessible carousel.”</blockquote>
</PolaroidCarousel>
```

### Controlled

```tsx
const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
<PolaroidCarousel items={items} index={index} onIndexChange={setIndex} />;
```

### Theme with CSS variables

```tsx
<PolaroidCarousel
  items={items}
  style={{
    "--rpc-card-width": "min(70%, 320px)",
    "--rpc-frame": "#fdf8ef",
    "--rpc-caption-font": "'Caveat', cursive",
    "--rpc-shadow": "0 24px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3)",
  } as React.CSSProperties}
/>
```

### Tailwind / your own styles

```tsx
<PolaroidCarousel
  items={items}
  unstyled
  classNames={{ slide: "rounded-xl bg-white p-3 shadow-xl", caption: "mt-2 text-center font-hand", dot: "size-6" }}
/>
```

### Headless

Build any markup you like on the same state machine (autoplay, swipe, keyboard, APG rules):

```tsx
import { useCarousel } from "react-polaroid-carousel";

function MySlider({ slides }: { slides: string[] }) {
  const c = useCarousel({ count: slides.length, autoplay: 4000 });
  return (
    <section ref={c.rootRef} {...c.rootProps} aria-roledescription="carousel" aria-label="Slides">
      <div {...c.swipeProps}>{slides[c.index]}</div>
      <button onClick={c.prev}>Prev</button>
      <button onClick={c.next}>Next</button>
      {c.hasAutoplay && <button onClick={c.toggleRotation}>{c.isRotationOn ? "Pause" : "Play"}</button>}
    </section>
  );
}
```

## Props

Everything is optional except `items` (or `children`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `PolaroidItem[]` | | `{ src, alt, caption?, srcSet?, sizes?, width?, height?, aspectRatio?, type?: "image" \| "video", poster? }` |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | | Custom slides (one per child), instead of `items` |
| `label` | `string` | `"Photo carousel"` | Accessible name of the carousel |
| `autoplay` | `boolean \| number` | `false` | `true` = 4000ms, or a delay in ms |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `true` | Wrap around at the ends |
| `index` / `defaultIndex` | `number` | `0` | Controlled / initial slide |
| `onIndexChange` | `(index) => void` | | Called on every slide change |
| `frame` | `"polaroid" \| "none"` | `"polaroid"` | Instant-photo frame, or bare cards |
| `visible` | `number` | `1` | Cards shown on each side |
| `spread` | `number` | `118` | Gap between cards, % of card width |
| `fan` | `number` | `6` | Extra rotation per step away (deg) |
| `tilt` | `number` | `4` | Max resting tilt (deg), `0` for straight |
| `scale` | `number` | `0.86` | Scale of non-active cards |
| `dots` | `boolean` | `true` | Dot navigation |
| `arrows` | `boolean` | `false` | Previous / next buttons |
| `draggable` | `boolean` | `true` | Swipe / drag |
| `swipeThreshold` | `number` | `50` | Pixels to trigger a slide change |
| `keyboard` | `boolean` | `true` | Arrow keys, Home, End |
| `pauseOnHover` | `boolean` | `true` | Pause autoplay on hover |
| `stopOnInteraction` | `boolean` | `true` | Stop autoplay after user interaction |
| `direction` | `"ltr" \| "rtl"` | `"ltr"` | Layout and gesture direction |
| `reducedMotion` | `"user" \| "always" \| "never"` | `"user"` | Follow the OS setting or force it |
| `priority` | `boolean` | `false` | Eager, high-priority active image (above the fold) |
| `duration` / `easing` | `number` / `string` | `600` / spring-like | Transition timing |
| `onSlideClick` | `(index) => void` | | Active card was clicked or activated (e.g. open the lightbox) |
| `renderImage` | `(item, ctx) => ReactNode` | | Replace the `<img>` |
| `renderSlide` | `(item, ctx) => ReactNode` | | Replace a slide's contents |
| `unstyled` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep layout + motion, drop visual styles |
| `className` / `style` | | | Root element |
| `classNames` | `{ root, stage, slide, frame, image, caption, dots, dot, arrow, rotationButton, openButton }` | | Class names for each part |
| `labels` | `Partial<PolaroidCarouselLabels>` | English | Override any text (i18n) |

`ctx` is `{ index, offset, active, visible, loading }`.

### `PolaroidLightbox` props

Import from `react-polaroid-carousel/lightbox`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `PolaroidItem[]` | | The same items as the carousel |
| `open` | `boolean` | | Show the lightbox |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | | Close button, Esc, or a click on the backdrop |
| `index` / `onIndexChange` | `number` / `(index) => void` | | Current photo; share it with the carousel |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `true` | Wrap around at the ends |
| `renderImage` | `(item, { index }) => ReactNode` | | Replace the full-size `<img>` / `<video>` |
| `className` / `style` | | | The `<dialog>` element |
| `labels` | `Partial<PolaroidLightboxLabels>` | English | `dialog`, `close`, `previous`, `next`, `position` |

## CSS variables

| Variable | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--rpc-card-width` | `min(60%, 260px)` |
| `--rpc-aspect` | `1` (square photos) |
| `--rpc-frame` | `#fff` |
| `--rpc-frame-padding` | `12px 12px 14px` |
| `--rpc-shadow` | soft drop shadow |
| `--rpc-radius` | `16px` (with `frame="none"`) |
| `--rpc-caption-font` | handwriting system fonts |
| `--rpc-caption-size` | `1.15rem` |
| `--rpc-caption-color` | `#1f1f1f` |
| `--rpc-dot` | `currentColor` |
| `--rpc-button-bg` / `--rpc-button-color` | translucent black / white |
| `--rpc-stage-padding` | `28px 0 36px` |
| `--rpc-lightbox-bg` | near-black, 97% opaque (lightbox) |

## Accessibility

- `section` with `aria-roledescription="carousel"` and a label; each slide is a `group` labelled "2 of 5"
- Only the active slide is in the accessibility tree and tab order (`inert`, never `aria-hidden` over focusable content)
- A polite live region announces slide changes, and is silenced while autoplay runs
- Autoplay has a visible pause/play button first in tab order, stops on keyboard focus, and starts paused with `prefers-reduced-motion`
- Keyboard: ← → Home End; every control is a real `<button>` with a 24px+ target

## Performance

- Layout is CSS grid, so there is no measuring, no resize observer and no layout shift
- Movement uses only `transform` and `opacity`; dragging updates CSS variables, not React state
- Only the active slide ±`visible + 1` are mounted, so 1,000 photos cost the same as 5
- Images are `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` unless you set `priority`

## Type definitions (react-polaroid-carousel@0.2.0)

Everything below is exported from "react-polaroid-carousel".

### PolaroidCarousel.d.ts

```ts
import { type CSSProperties, type ReactElement, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { type UseCarouselOptions } from "./use-carousel.js";
export interface PolaroidItem {
    /** Image URL. */
    src: string;
    /** Alt text (required for accessibility; use "" only for purely decorative images). */
    alt: string;
    /** Handwritten-style caption under the photo. */
    caption?: ReactNode;
    srcSet?: string;
    sizes?: string;
    /** Intrinsic width, helps the browser reserve space. */
    width?: number;
    /** Intrinsic height, helps the browser reserve space. */
    height?: number;
    /** Crop this photo to its own aspect ratio, e.g. "4 / 3" for a wide shot. Defaults to `--rpc-aspect` (square). */
    aspectRatio?: string;
    /** "video" plays `src` as a muted, looping clip while its slide is active and shows `poster` otherwise. @default "image" */
    type?: "image" | "video";
    /** Still image for a video item: shown while the slide is inactive and before the clip loads. */
    poster?: string;
}
/** Passed to `renderImage` and `renderSlide`. */
export interface SlideContext {
    /** Position in `items` / children. */
    index: number;
    /** Distance from the active slide: 0 active, -1 previous, 1 next. */
    offset: number;
    /** This is the active slide. */
    active: boolean;
    /** Within `visible` steps of the active slide (painted on screen). */
    visible: boolean;
    /** Suggested `loading` attribute for images in this slide. */
    loading: "eager" | "lazy";
}
export type PolaroidCarouselSlot = "root" | "stage" | "slide" | "frame" | "image" | "caption" | "dots" | "dot" | "arrow" | "rotationButton" | "openButton";
export interface PolaroidCarouselLabels {
    carousel: string;
    slide: (position: number, total: number) => string;
    goTo: (position: number) => string;
    previous: string;
    next: string;
    pause: string;
    play: string;
    /** Name of the button over the active slide when `onSlideClick` is set. */
    open: (position: number, total: number) => string;
}
export interface PolaroidCarouselProps extends Omit<UseCarouselOptions, "count" | "onDragMove"> {
    /** Photos to show. Use `children` instead for fully custom slides. */
    items?: readonly PolaroidItem[];
    /** Custom slides: each child becomes one slide (wrapped in the frame unless `frame="none"`). */
    children?: ReactNode;
    /** Accessible name for the carousel region. @default "Photo carousel" */
    label?: string;
    /** "polaroid": white instant-photo frame with caption. "none": bare rounded cards. @default "polaroid" */
    frame?: "polaroid" | "none";
    /** Horizontal distance between cards, as % of card width. @default 118 */
    spread?: number;
    /** Extra rotation per step away from the active card, in degrees. @default 6 */
    fan?: number;
    /** Maximum resting tilt, in degrees (0 for a straight stack). @default 4 */
    tilt?: number;
    /** Scale of non-active cards. @default 0.86 */
    scale?: number;
    /** How many cards to show on each side of the active one. @default 1 */
    visible?: number;
    /** Show dot navigation. @default true */
    dots?: boolean;
    /** Show previous / next buttons. @default false */
    arrows?: boolean;
    /** Load the active image eagerly with high fetch priority (use for above-the-fold carousels). @default false */
    priority?: boolean;
    /** Transition length in ms. @default 600 */
    duration?: number;
    /** Transition timing function. @default "cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)" */
    easing?: string;
    /** Replace the `<img>` (e.g. with Next.js `<Image>`). */
    renderImage?: (item: PolaroidItem, context: SlideContext) => ReactNode;
    /**
     * Called when the active slide is clicked, or activated with Enter / Space (e.g. to open
     * `PolaroidLightbox`). Adds an accessible button over the active slide. A swipe never triggers it.
     */
    onSlideClick?: (index: number) => void;
    /** Replace a whole slide's contents (frame included unless `frame="none"`). */
    renderSlide?: (item: PolaroidItem, context: SlideContext) => ReactNode;
    /** Drop all visual styling (colors, frame, shadows, fonts), keep only layout and motion. */
    unstyled?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    style?: CSSProperties;
    /** Class names for inner parts. */
    classNames?: Partial<Record<PolaroidCarouselSlot, string>>;
    /** Override any text (for i18n). */
    labels?: Partial<PolaroidCarouselLabels>;
}
/**
 * A swipeable, accessible stack of tilted polaroid photos.
 *
 * @example
 * <PolaroidCarousel
 *   items={[{ src: "/beach.jpg", alt: "Beach at sunset", caption: "summer '25" }]}
 *   autoplay
 * />
 */
export declare function PolaroidCarousel(props: PolaroidCarouselProps): ReactElement;
```

### use-carousel.d.ts

```ts
import { type FocusEvent, type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent, type PointerEvent, type RefCallback } from "react";
export interface UseCarouselOptions {
    /** Number of slides. */
    count: number;
    /** Controlled active index. Pair with `onIndexChange`. */
    index?: number;
    /** Starting index when uncontrolled. @default 0 */
    defaultIndex?: number;
    /** Called with the new index whenever the user or autoplay changes slides. */
    onIndexChange?: (index: number) => void;
    /** Wrap from the last slide to the first and back. @default true */
    loop?: boolean;
    /**
     * Auto-advance. `true` uses 4000ms; a number sets the delay in ms.
     * Pauses on hover, while the tab is hidden, while scrolled off screen, and
     * stays paused after the user interacts (unless `stopOnInteraction` is false).
     * Starts paused when the OS asks for reduced motion.
     * @default false
     */
    autoplay?: boolean | number;
    /** Pause autoplay while the pointer is over the carousel. @default true */
    pauseOnHover?: boolean;
    /** Keep autoplay paused after a swipe, key press, dot click or keyboard focus. @default true */
    stopOnInteraction?: boolean;
    /** Enable swipe / drag to change slides. @default true */
    draggable?: boolean;
    /** Pixels a swipe must travel to change slides. @default 50 */
    swipeThreshold?: number;
    /** Arrow keys, Home and End change slides while focus is inside the carousel. @default true */
    keyboard?: boolean;
    /** Layout and gesture direction. @default "ltr" */
    direction?: "ltr" | "rtl";
    /**
     * Follow the OS reduced-motion setting ("user"), or force it on or off.
     * Reduced motion disables transitions and starts autoplay paused.
     * @default "user"
     */
    reducedMotion?: "user" | "always" | "never";
    /** Receives the live horizontal drag distance in px (0 when released). Use it to move slides without re-rendering. */
    onDragMove?: (dx: number) => void;
}
export interface CarouselApi {
    /** Active slide index. */
    index: number;
    count: number;
    loop: boolean;
    /** Go to a slide. Out-of-range values wrap (loop) or clamp. */
    goTo: (index: number) => void;
    next: () => void;
    prev: () => void;
    canPrev: boolean;
    canNext: boolean;
    /** Autoplay was configured (a delay is set). */
    hasAutoplay: boolean;
    /** Slides are advancing right now. */
    isPlaying: boolean;
    /** What the rotation button should offer: true means "pause". */
    isRotationOn: boolean;
    /** Start or stop autoplay (the APG "rotation control"). */
    toggleRotation: () => void;
    /** The user is mid-swipe. */
    isDragging: boolean;
    /** Reduced motion is in effect. */
    reducedMotion: boolean;
    /** Attach to the outer element (used to pause autoplay while it's off screen). */
    rootRef: RefCallback<HTMLElement>;
    /** Spread on the outer element: hover, focus and keyboard handlers. */
    rootProps: {
        onMouseEnter: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
        onMouseLeave: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
        onFocus: (event: FocusEvent) => void;
        onKeyDown: (event: KeyboardEvent) => void;
    };
    /** Spread on the element that receives swipes. */
    swipeProps: {
        onPointerDown: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
        onPointerMove: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
        onPointerUp: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
        onPointerCancel: (event: PointerEvent) => void;
        onClickCapture: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
        style: {
            touchAction: "pan-y";
        };
    };
}
/**
 * Headless carousel state: index, autoplay, swipe, keyboard and accessibility
 * rules, with no markup or styles. `<PolaroidCarousel>` is built on it; use it
 * directly to render a completely custom carousel.
 */
export declare function useCarousel(options: UseCarouselOptions): CarouselApi;
```

### math.d.ts

```ts
/** Wraps any integer into the range `0..count-1`. */
export declare function wrapIndex(index: number, count: number): number;
/** Keeps an index valid: wraps when looping, clamps otherwise. */
export declare function normalizeIndex(index: number, count: number, loop: boolean): number;
/**
 * Signed distance from the active slide to slide `index`.
 * `0` is the active slide, `-1` the one before it, `1` the one after it.
 * When looping, takes the shortest way round, so the last slide sits just
 * before the first one.
 */
export declare function slideOffset(index: number, active: number, count: number, loop: boolean): number;
/** Deterministic resting tilt for slide `index`, in degrees. */
export declare function restingTilt(index: number, tilt: number): number;
```
